meaning:
ὑπο-φέρω
[in LXX for נָשָׂא, etc. ;]
to bear by being under. Metaphorical, to endure: with accusative of thing(s), 1Co.10:13, 2Ti.3:11, 1Pe.2:19.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the…
persecutions, and sufferings: those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them…
For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.
